caption:
Anthropic is set to deploy 2 gigawatts of AMD GPUs, valued at up to $5 billion, to enhance its Claude models. This significant investment will kick off with the first gigawatt phase starting in early 2027. 💻🔋

Will this deal position AMD as a leading GPU supplier for AI?
